==Description==
'''Hotline''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|1,500}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/113381854/profile Falosaur]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

== Trivia ==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] is based on a dance that Drake performs in the music video of his song, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uxpDa-c-4Mc Hotline Bling], hence the name of this emote.
**The music used for this emote is a remixed version of the song.
**The store description is one of the lines in the song.
